Prefab Container Office with Bi-fold Glass Doors

Sustainable, Rapid-Deploy, and Fully Customizable Workspace Solutions

A prefab container office with bi-fold glass doors is engineered for businesses that need a professional, fully enclosed space without the cost or timeline of conventional construction. Built at our ISO-certified factory in [Location], China, every unit is pre-assembled, inspected, and flat-packed for freight efficiency before it ships to your site.

Bi-fold door container offices feature full-length side access that increases ventilation and workspace flexibility compared to standard containers. These container office units allow the entire wall to open, creating a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces, making them ideal for construction sites, event management, educational, or retail spaces.

Specification of Prefab Container Offices

Structural Frame Galvanized steel with bolt-connected corner castings
Exterior Cladding Color-coated steel panels option available
Front Facade Full-width aluminum bi-fold glass doors
Side Entry Door Solid steel single-leaf door with key lock
Interior Partition Glass sliding door dividing the front area and the rear room
Interior Wall Finish Wood-grain PVC laminate panel
Flooring Grey plank
Ceiling Grey PVC board with LED flush-mount light
Base Frame Forklift-compatible steel base with recessed lifting points
Finish Color Custom colors available
Electrical Pre-wired; track lighting + dual power outlets per zone

To receive a quote, you only share your intended use, required footprint, site location, quantity, and any branding requirements. We will return a proposal and container office layout drawings.

Who Uses Modular Prefab Container Offices?

On-Site Construction Office: Provide lockable workspaces equipped with power for temporary container offices at any construction site.

Remote or Mobile Offices: Mining, oil, and gas companies set up on-site offices in remote areas for business expansion or as temporary workspaces.

Pop-Up Retail and Brand Activations: Ideal for seasonal boutiques and holiday promotional booths, allowing your business to operate even in limited spaces.

Ticket Booths and Tourist Centers: Suitable for visitor entrances and ticket halls. The separate room at the rear can be used as a cash handling or security office.

Resort and Glamping Reception: It can be used as a temporary check-in kiosk during peak travel seasons to avoid long wait times caused by large crowds, thereby enhancing the guest check-in experience.

Medical Screening and Triage: The dual-zone layout separates waiting from examination areas, making this unit a solution for vaccination drives, health screenings, and outbreak response.

Product Showrooms: It can be used as a temporary reception area outside the showroom or dealership to accommodate visitors.

Classroom and Training Room: Multiple flatpack container units can be placed side by side and connected through shared wall openings to create larger educational spaces for remote or temporary facilities.

Since each modular container office unit is custom-built to your specifications, the entire process begins with a discussion of your needs. From initial contact through to final delivery and installation, we will need you to provide us with your specific requirements. You can visit our YouTube channel to watch a demonstration video of this product.

What Customizations for Container Offices Offer?

As a leading manufacturer of container offices, NEW BRAND constructs its units using weather-resistant steel and insulated panels to ensure stability and safety. Their modular design enables rapid on-site assembly, shortening construction timelines and promoting sustainability. Compared to traditional methods, prefabricated container office solutions not only conserve resources but also offer comprehensive customization in terms of size, layout, finishes, and functionality to meet your unique needs. Whether for temporary offices, project sites, creative studios, or mobile exhibitions, they are perfectly suited for the task.

- Footprint/Dimensions: We offer standard 20-foot and 40-foot container office units, as well as custom-sized container offices to meet your specific space requirements.

- Insulation Specification: Insulation (e.g., rock wool or PU foam), HVAC systems, and electrical fit-outs for professional offices.

- Flooring and Interiors: Options for vinyl, wood laminate, or aluminum diamond plate flooring.

- Cladding: Exterior timber or metal cladding for a non-industrial, modern look.

- Security Features: Added lockboxes, reinforced steel frames, and multiple locking bars.


If you would like to learn more about our customization options, please request a custom quote. Please let us know your location, intended use, and any branding requirements. We will provide renderings and a comprehensive quote. No matter what stage of your project you're at, we'll respond quickly and provide you with the most thoughtful solutions.

Contact our sales team today: NEW BRAND@NEW BRAND.com

Frequently Asked Questions

1
How long does it take to assemble once the unit arrives on site?
Because the interior — flooring, wall panels, ceiling, lighting, and wiring — is pre-finished at the factory, less on-site finish work is required. You position the container office on the foundation, connect your power to the pre-run feed point, and you're operational. NEW BRAND provides an assembly manual, and our technical team is available by video call to guide installers.
2
Can the prefab container office unit be relocated after being installed?
Of course. You can use a forklift or crane to lift the container office into place at its new location. Many customers take advantage of this flexibility to move their temporary offices from one construction site to the next once their current project is complete.
3
Is the modular office container weatherproof? Can it be used in cold or rainy climates?
All panel joints in our modular container offices are sealed with weatherproof construction. The entire frame of the folding glass doors is fitted with rubber gaskets. For cold climates, we offer upgraded wall solutions featuring rock wool or EPS sandwich panels, double-pane low-emissivity glass, and reinforced roof supports. Please specify your climate zone when requesting a quote.
4
What customization options are available for container offices?
NEW BRAND offers customization options for all major components. Exterior wall colors can be matched to any RAL standard color chart; panel cladding profiles, window placement, door swing direction, and signage rail positions are all configurable. For the interior, you can choose from various wall panel finishes, flooring materials, partition configurations, lighting types, and whether to include sink and drain openings. Units can also be ordered in non-standard lengths (20 to 40 feet), combined units, or stacked to 3 stories to be a prefab modular office building.
5
Does the prefab office container unit require a building permit?
Building permit requirements vary by country, state, and city. In many areas, modular structures used for temporary or semi-permanent commercial purposes do not require a full building permit. We recommend that you contact local regulations before proceeding to avoid unnecessary financial losses.
6
Can multiple units be stacked or connected?
Yes. The corner casting system is compatible with standard ISO container stacking hardware, allowing units to be placed two stories high. Multiple units can also be placed side by side and fitted with connecting wall openings to create a larger, multi-room floorplate. NEW BRAND has delivered connected multi-unit configurations for clinics, resort reception complexes, and temporary office parks.
